column8: Mon 23 Nov: store only, no part (Everest stays out: 3c has the RBA, 3e the gilt crisis, H2-053's opposite sign); it corrects H2-053's 'set the turn-back hour before the climb': Hall never declared his hour.

Mon 23 Nov: Table 3 row 5 (3e), a drafting guard only, no Everest words: keep row 5's one exception to market plumbing (a halt, prices more than 0.5% off net asset value), never keyed to how near the top is to a $5,000 step; adds no rule (A34).
Mon 23 Nov: store only: a rule announced in public was left to one man on the day; Boukreev and DeWalt p. 145 seen only through Roberto's citation.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: only four kept the turnaround time; Roberto's 1:00 p.m. count clashes with the HBS exhibit (row 13), so any count names its source.
Mon 23 Nov: store only, evidence for verdict 2: the rule broke for the late climber below his goal, not on the easy day; no part takes Everest.

Mon 23 Nov: store only, never in 3c: the team works for Laura and wants the same top, so 'a keeper who does not share the goal' overclaims; 3c's order (the trade placed, then the figure stated) rests on IPS l.15 alone.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: a third guide without standing did not turn paying clients back; Roberto's psychological-safety frame is beyond a two-party plan.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: the kind-day turn (Kropp, an hour below the top, praised above a summit) supports the kind-market half of verdict 2; his own reason, not a rule; never in 3f (D16).

Mon 23 Nov: Table 3 row 5's basis or note, without Everest: NUMBERS 8r's 8.4% of house paths (13.1% by July) with VT down more than 10% between the dates, the top lower in 56.3% (65.2%) of them, checked; the squall quote stays in the store.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: good seasons made the rule feel needless (quotes, not counts); the kind-market pull of verdict 2.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: a kept rule's cost shows and its benefit does not; 8r's 12.0% lower against 16.4% higher (checked) is row 31's job, judged by both sides, never by the year that happens.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: rivalry stretched the times (Krakauer's inference); the co-sponsor link is thin, since nothing is stated before the move anyway (row 18).
Mon 23 Nov: store only, a method guard: the four accounts' summit times differ by 5-17 minutes, so the report uses no Everest times.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: late summits marked the deaths on Everest 1921-2006 (BMJ, correlational); 3e's one parallel is the 2022 gilt crisis (D6).
Mon 23 Nov: the same point as row 25 (knowing or being reminded does not keep a sale; a sale fixed in advance does), which holds the experimental evidence; Roberto's version rests on Everest.
Mon 23 Nov: store, a guard beside H2-053 and D6: the Everest lesson is contested (Elmes and Frame, abstract only; Boukreev), one more reason no part tells it.
Mon 23 Nov: store only, input to row 18: Kayes's warning signs read only as Ordonez et al. list them; the book not read.

Mon 23 Nov: 3c, not a new aha (3c holds two; aha 7 already says speaking early with these figures, checked against NUMBERS 4): fold in as aha 7's reason in Laura's terms (a figure once stated is one people defend, with H7-064), no Everest or Kayes words; the link is Keel's reading, untested.
Mon 23 Nov: the same idea as row 21 (goals raise risk-taking), which cites the experiments; this paper leans on Everest and is disputed (row 20).
Mon 23 Nov: store, a guard: the goals critique is disputed, so cite row 21's experiments, never Ordonez et al.'s anecdotes.

Mon 23 Nov: 3c, one clause at most with row 24, evidence for which day tests the move (just below a hoped-for step the pull to wait is stronger); drop the $2,858 or enter it in NUMBERS ($117,142 checks, 8r); say a wish, never a goal Laura holds or states.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: cab drivers stopping at a daily target, seen only as Ordonez et al. report Camerer et al. (1997); later tests unchecked.
Mon 23 Nov: 3c store, evidence for verdict 2's two pulls (house money after a gain, break-even after a loss); lab gambles with small stakes; one clause at most, with rows 21 and 24.

Mon 23 Nov: 3c, one clause at most: investors realise gains about 1.5 times as readily as losses (Odean 1998 Table 1, 0.148 against 0.098; Keel arithmetic), so the move after a rally is the easy sale and the rule earns its keep after a fall.

Mon 23 Nov: Table 3 row 5 and one clause in 3c, finance's own literature (D6): a sale fixed in advance beat reminders; say the move is a trade fixed by date in the IPS, never automatic, stop-loss or take-gain (price-triggered: 3b's design not taken, H6-096; A34); abstracts only.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: the IPS takes no market view (l.17), so never imply low returns follow a rally; at most, waiting for more rests on a forecast; US surveys, nothing on a 3-month wait.

Mon 23 Nov: 3c wording guard only, no aviation in the prose (3c's parallel is the RBA): say the move as a scheduled step of the plan, never an exit, a turn back or a go-around, so the pull to continue works for it.

Mon 23 Nov: for the lead's wording, not the report (no aviation in 3c or 3e): a date set in advance does not keep a rule, nothing left to judge does; never 'broken 97 times in 100' (about 97 of 100 unstable approaches go on to land, a small share of all flights).

Mon 23 Nov: Table 3 row 5 (3e), a sentence of method at most, no aviation words: keep the one exception to plumbing so no judgment is left on the day (Q7b-028's bright line in practice); adds no trigger (A34).
Mon 23 Nov: store, pedigree only: Table 3's columns (signal, reader, carry on while, act when) already answer the three questions.

Mon 23 Nov: Table 3 row 5's Never cell may name a wait for a better share price (a negative, no new rule, A34): the price in Laura's units, checked against NUMBERS 8r ($236 and $451 of mean; 12.0% lower against 16.4% higher); never confuse with Q115-025's 12.0% or Q109-029's $236.
Mon 23 Nov: store only: one replayed window (2020) shows a wait can cost a step and give it back; NUMBERS 8r's named case runs on US stock history, so say US stocks stood in for VT.

Mon 23 Nov: refuse for 3f: the reflection is told plain from Caplet's own record and takes no outside story, even as framing (D16); the team's turn told as a decision is already the tree's Branch 7; the Kropp fact stays in row 8.

Mon 23 Nov: Table 3 row 5 and the tree's 'before the 2031 meetings': say 'never past the first 2031 meeting', IPS l.15's 'Before you meet co-sponsors in 2031' (NUMBERS 8r: only a January move is before every first meeting); coherence, no new rule; Q176-024 and Q214-030 carry the old words; the lead's call.
